mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting aerobic ATP renewal to the sodium-potassium pump was most worthwhile: it linked fuel use to cellular work and contrasted powered transport with passive flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Installing the pump was straightforward preparation rather than an especially engaging step, although the channel comparison gave it context.

surprise.text: The mitochondrial plan distinguished fuel oxidation from oxygen's role in electron transfer and showed hydrogen-ion flow through ATP synthase; the connection was useful but condensed.

arbitrary.text: No chosen action felt purposeless. The compatible oxygen-and-carrier option was not explained, but I did not select it, so its result is unknown.

continue.text: I would continue: linking membrane transport, ATP renewal and protein production made the constructions useful, and I would be curious to see how later chapters connect cells to tissues.
